Vraiment ? Are the records lost over time, or do you suspect they were simply deemed not important enough to remember ?
We don't know very much about the people who were turned into the original warframes, I'm afraid.
There isn't much known about the original Wisp, I'm afraid.
If the discussion of souls does not trouble you ? I understand if it shall, and we can curtail it to more practical things, I do not wish to make you uncomfortable.
I think they weren't important enough to remember.
I think they were lost over time.
A little bit of both, in the end. They were... part weapon, part artwork, to their primary creator.
Vraiment ? For I feel as though I know her as if she were my own sister - and one of my own blood, not one of the Cathédrale.
It's all right, we can talk about souls.
I don't really believe in souls, so we should keep it to hard facts, if possible?
[End.]
You see ? Ces Orokin, they are devils.
+5 Chemistry
I do not hear her, not the way Lyon hears the gods and his patron spirits. I do not see her. I simply feel her there, beside me.
[End.]

Weapons can be used to protect as well as to harm. We don't like that we need them, but... we do.
Not all of them. But that one? Yes. There are still some around that I wouldn't condemn immediately.
Une horrible toile d'os peinte avec du sang... you see ? Ces Orokin, they are devils.
Like an old friend, perhaps. I know what she liked, I know how she moved. I remember the sound of her laughter on the wind...
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
Add -1 to Thermostat
Add 1 to Thermostat
I must sound quite mad to you ! Forgive me.
Oui, bien sûr ! No one wishes to be lectured, least of all by a Sister. I understand. Merci, I would not have wanted to make a fool of myself.
Yes, that is true. I am a weapon now, as the Murmure well know ! But I seek to follow the path le Cardinal put me upon, blessed as it is.
Like le Cardinal. He was Orokin, non ? And he certainly is not one I would condemn. Without him, I would not be as I am now. Blessed.
Warframes were... not made in the kindest of ways. I just hope she's not trapped inside the Infestation.
I think that whoever Wisp was, she would be happy to know you.
I hope their souls have been able to move on and be at rest, but I think some part of their memory remains.
Not at all. I believe some part of the people who were turned into warframes remain within their core schematics.
[End.]
There's a lot I could argue with him about, but I will say that he seems to have a good instinct about whom to give which protoframe serum. Even if I don't know why he does it.
I wish you wouldn't trust Entrati as much as you do. We don't know why he chooses to do what he does, and his motives are unclear.
We have to stick with Entrati. I think we have to just follow where he goes. He's our only chance of stopping the Indifference.
He's a liar, Marie. He abandons and hurts everyone in his life. He's already abandoned you, don't you see?

I have only been told of the Infestation, I know little of it... but I believe you. And if what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, I do not think she is trapped.
That is quite sweet of you to say. If what I feel is the truth, and I pray that she is, then oui, I think you are right. I do not think she is trapped.
If what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, then non, I do not think she is trapped.
If what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, then oui, you are right. And they stay to help us. I do not think she is trapped.
Oui, I have been blessed by le Cardinal... but I know I am near to singular in my love for him, for it is not sullied by sorrow, hatred, or resentment.
I know you think him to be some kind of terrible monster. But I must ask, what made you distrust him so ?
MarieEntratiMonster1
I thought you believed in him ? Why the sudden change in heart ? Are you so fickle ?
MarieEntratiFan1

false

MarieEntratiMonster1

DrifterFaithSol

false
From her, I only feel the warmth of Sol's smile upon me. Le Cardinal was wise, I think, in his choice. I am honored to carry her in my veins.
I forgive him for leaving us. I do not think anyone else does...
He... came to Duviri. A long time ago...
Well, to start, he shot me in the chest and left me for dead.
He leaves nothing but pain, death, and abandonment in his wake.
I've never trusted him, I just didn't want to scare you off.
I didn't mean to lie earlier, I just didn't know how to approach the subject. You clearly adore him...
Update boolean MarieNoDate
Yes, we must stay strong ! Braves contre les ténèbres, pour toujours et à jamais !
Update boolean DrifterCrossroads
He's hurt and abandoned a lot of people, you're right. And I think he feels like he's had to.
It's hard, when someone who means that much to you - who you love and rely on, goes away. Especially if you don't know why. Or they don't come back.
Sol ! This world that you made, summoned from the book his daughter wrote, oui ? Monsieur Loid spoke of it... Le Cardinal was there ? Why ?
Et pourtant, vous êtes toujours en vie ! You are alive, are you not ? And well? And thriving, if Monsieur Loid's tales of your adventures in the past-future are to be believed.

Ah, je vois ! Je suis une idiote, c'est ça ?! Juste une petite invalide venue d'un passé lointain, incapable de penser par elle-même ?! Mieux vaut l'approcher comme un faon dans les bois, de peur de l'effrayer !
Ah, oui... I have not made it easy for you to speak the truth, n'est-ce pas ?
Chat ends.
I have forgiven him for leaving us. I do not think anyone else does...
Le Cardinal must find his way back to us. We can only do what we can to help him when he calls, and do as we are bid by those who are blessed as he.

I think at first, some part of him was there seeking a bit of the daughter he left behind. But instead, he found a way to fight the Indifference - with the emotions he sought to distance himself from.
His notes tell a very obnoxiously self-flattering story of how he went to study conceptual embodiment and instead came away learning the value of fighting the Indifference.
If his notes are to be believed, he was there to teach Duviri - and by extension me, how to defend against the Indifference. For what good it did in the end.

Va t'asseoir sur une ruche.
Tell me the truth now then, wolf. Why do you believe he is not to be trusted? And I shall aspire to keep my temper.

Oui, you are correct. I think guilt haunts his him for all he has done. I think he distances himself from others very much intentionally.
Oui, it is a terrible grief, an awful pain. To know that someone is... still alive, and seemingly chooses not to be beside you ?
Mon cœur se brise dans la tragédie - I do not think I can take the sadness of that... and still, she will not forgive him ?
Do you know why he left ?
What do you mean ?
Indeed if the rumors amongst the Cavia are true, vous y avez vraiment trouvé beaucoup de joie, non ?
true
